sections.section: ORDER - President's Order 23, Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) (Thirteenth Amendment) Order 1985
sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 23 OF 1985
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
23 OF 1985
HOUSES OF
PARLIAMENT AND PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES (ELECTIONS) (THIRTEENTH AMENDMENT) ORDER,
1985
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 19th Match, 1985]
No. F. 17 (3)/85-Pub.-The
following Order made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
In pursuance of the Proclamation
of the fifth day of July, 1977, acid in exercise of all powers enabling him in
that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order
1. Short title acid
commencement.-(1) This Order may be called the Houses of Parliament and
Provincial Assemblies (Elections) (Thirteenth Amendment) Order, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Article 10, P.
(P. P.) O No. 5 df 1977.--to the Houses of Parliament and Provincial
Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977 [P. (P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977], hereinafter
referred to as the said Order, in Article 10, in clause (2), in paragraph (b),
sub-paragraph (10) shall be omitted and shall be deemed always to have been
omitted.
3. Insertion of new Article
1l-A, P. (P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977.--In the said Order, after Article 11,
the following new Article shall be inserted, namely :-
"11-A.
Election of certain persons may be declared void.-(1) The Commissioner or a
person authorised by him in this behalf shall declare the election of the
husband, wife, son or daughter of a person who holds any office of profit in
the service of Pakistan other than an office specified in sub-paragraph (9) of
paragraph (b) of clause (2) of Article 10 to be void if, after providing an
opportunity of being heard to the person elected, he is satisfied that such
holder of public office has exercised his influence, or used his position, in
such manner that the result of the election has been materially affected
thereby ; and, upon the issue of such declaration, the person to whom the
declaration relates shall cease to be a member of the House or, as the case may
be, Provincial Assembly and his seat shall become vacant.
(2) A
declaration issued under clause (1) shall not be called in question in or
before any Court or other authority on any ground whatsoever.".
4. Omission of Article 3, P.
O. No. 18 of 1985.--In the Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies
(Elections) (Eleventh Amendment) Order, 1985 (P. O. No. 18 of 1985) Article 3
shall be omitted and shall be deemed always to have been omitted.
